observations: Account verified: sidebar 'Linh explorer' / linh-explorer.myshopify.com / Blue (Test); network request GET /api/user carried header x-acting-user-id: 266. Matches required scope (sub=273/user_id=266). No action taken on Linh Pham (sub=2).
Add-layer asset picker for BOTH 'Clipart Category' sub-types shows exactly 2 tabs: 'Upload an image' and 'Choose from clipart category' -- verbatim label text unchanged from prior evidence.

The 'Choose from clipart category' tab's category tree renders EMPTY ('Select a category on the left', no items) even for a brand-new user with 10+ existing clipart_categories rows (confirmed via GraphQL query response). Root cause traced to REST endpoint GET /api/layer-image-categories?type=clipart returning `[]` while a parallel GraphQL query (clipart_categories table) returns real data. Reproduced 2 additional times on separate surfaces (see conflicts/unknowns).

Layer config panel is NOT a persistent sidebar in this modal-based artwork editor UI. The only way found to reach Personalization/Populate/Design/Conditional/Extra settings for a layer -- even with exactly 1 layer selected -- is via the layer's '...' menu -> 'Bulk edit' dialog. Direct single-layer settings panel was not found despite trying: double-click (renames layer instead), right-click (no context menu), clicking the SVG canvas element directly, and the artwork-level gear icon (opens unrelated grid/snap toggle) and 'Preview Options' panel (unrelated, template/print variant selector).

DESIGN SETTINGS accordion ('Select one clipart category:' / 'Select a group of clipart categories:' + default-value picker) only renders meaningful content when PERSONALIZATION SETTINGS -> 'Personalization for this layer' is set to 'Create a new option'. With 'No personalization' (default/unset) it renders as an empty ~15px strip. This condition was not documented in prior evidence and is recorded as a new structural finding.

clipart-category (single) sub-type field inventory confirmed via Bulk Edit, 1 layer selected: DESIGN SETTINGS = 'Select one clipart category:' + 'Clipart category's default value:' (toggle 'Show option to select default value'); PERSONALIZATION SETTINGS = radio 'Personalization for this layer' (No personalization / Create a new option / Use an existing global option) -> when 'Create a new option': 'Option Title:', 'Add instruction for customer:', 'Mark this option as required:' (On/No change/Off tri-state in Bulk Edit), 'Show customization data on cart/checkout:' (On/No change/Off); EXTRA = 'Display this layer on:' radio (Mockup Preview & Order design / Mockup Preview only / Order Design only / None). POPULATE VALUES and CONDITIONAL SETTING accordions were left collapsed/unexplored (not required for this sub-type per baseline FEAT-04).

'Custom class:' field was NOT found anywhere in the Bulk Edit dialog for the clipart-category (single) layer, across Design/Personalization/Extra sections, fully scrolled to bottom. Prior evidence (profile.json capability list, layer-image.md) lists 'Custom class' as a field of this sub-type. This is recorded as a CONFLICT (see conflicts[]), not resolved here.

group-clipart-categories sub-type field inventory (delta vs single type): DESIGN SETTINGS label is 'Select a group of clipart categories:' (singular selection UI observed -- see conflicts[] re: 'group' semantics) + 'Group's default value:' (rendered as a SELECT/COMBOBOX, not a thumbnail grid like the single type); PERSONALIZATION SETTINGS additionally has 'Placeholder text:' field (default ghost text 'Choose something...') positioned between Option Title and Add instruction, which the single type does not have.

API field mapping confirmed via actual PUT /api/artworks/4339 response body (schema_version 2): single type layer keys = type:'clipart-category', clipart:<category_id>, customization_type:'normal' (enum value for 'Create a new option'), form_label, required, fit_mode/direct_upload_style/direct_clipart_style:'contain', default_value:<file path>. Group type layer keys = type:'group-clipart-categories', grouped_clipart:<category_id> (DIFFERENT key name from single type's 'clipart'), form_label, form_placeholder (group-only), default_value, grouped_reposition:[] (empty array, purpose not explored further), customization_type:'normal'.

Image file path shape confirmed for 3 pre-generated variants per uploaded image, independent of any category Preview/Thumbnail size setting: master (no suffix, original), '<hash>_large.webp' (used for canvas/print rendering url, and also referenced by layer.default_value), '<hash>_thumbnail.webp' (used for small list-row thumbnails, 28x28 CSS box observed). This matches prior artwork kb.json evidence about '_large' suffix usage.

Clipart category 'Preview size' and 'Thumbnail size' fields (Max-width display group, category create/edit form) confirmed with REAL enumerated values via DOM: Preview size options = 100/150/200/250/300/400/500(default)/700/1000/1600 px. Thumbnail size options = 100(default)/300/500 px. Changed Thumbnail size 100px -> 300px for test category id 6202 (clipart_thumbnail_size:300 confirmed in POST /api/clipart-categories response). Preview size left at default 500px (clipart_max_width:500).

Category create/edit form additionally exposes (not previously documented with this granularity): 'Custom class' (free text, category-level, distinct from the missing layer-level Custom class field noted above), 'Display options on personalization form as:' radio group with 5 modes (Thumbnail Images [default] / Dropdown list of Clipart name / Dropdown list of Clipart name + Thumbnail / Inline button of Clipart name / Radio of Clipart name), and 'Show option name on hover' toggle (off by default, tooltip on thumbnail hover). These directly control NHOM 4 buyer-facing display and are portal-side config; actual storefront rendering per mode was NOT tested here (out of scope, handed to storefront-explorer).

'Group's default value' combobox for the group-clipart-categories layer showed literal text 'List is empty.' after linking category 6202, despite that same category's 2 items rendering correctly with thumbnails moments earlier in the single-type layer's own default-value picker in the same session. This is the clearest, most specific manifestation of the category/item-listing anomaly (3rd distinct surface, see conflicts[]).

TASK-2a/2b mechanism observed directly (not inferred): picking an image via the 'Upload an image' tab at add-layer time sets layer.url (canvas rendering source) immediately -- confirmed image appeared on canvas right after selection, and persisted as the SAME file after Save & Close and reopening the artwork. Separately, 'Clipart category's default value' picker lets merchant EXPLICITLY choose any single item within the linked category (not automatically 'first item added') -- selecting item 'no2' (the 2nd uploaded item, position 2) worked immediately with a checkmark UI and 'Clear default value' button, proving arbitrary explicit selection rather than a fixed positional default. These two values (layer.url vs layer.default_value) are stored as SEPARATE JSON keys and did NOT converge: after reopening the saved artwork, canvas still rendered layer.url ('cat1', the original upload-tab pick), not layer.default_value ('no2'). Which one actually drives the storefront buyer's initial personalization state is unverified here -- see conflicts[] TASK-2c and handoff note to storefront-explorer.

Validation message captured verbatim: 'Template - Default template: cat1: - Select one clipart category is required' (red toast, top-right, after attempting Save & Close with customization_type unset / no category linked). Confirms 'Select one clipart category' is enforced server-side as required once the layer type is clipart-category, matching the 2-tier validation pattern documented for other layer types (FEAT-07/KB-051).

Test artwork 'QA-TEST-clipart-category-CTX20260921-03' (id 4339) created with 2 layers: 'cat1' (clipart-category, category 6202, default_value=no2, Option Title='Select your clipart') and 'body' (group-clipart-categories, grouped_clipart=6202, Option Title='Select your clipart group', Placeholder='Choose a design', default_value=null because the picker was broken).

Test campaign 'QA-TEST-clipart-category-campaign-CTX20260921-03' (id 2626) created, product base 'Vertical Framed Poster' (product-id 3181) attached, artwork 4339 assigned to both print areas (12x18 and 24x36), campaign validated ('Your campaign is valid and ready to launch!') and launched to store 'linh-explorer' (org 'Linh explorer' also has a second connected store 'linh-explorer-2', NOT used). Published product URL: https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/products/qa-test-clipart-category-campaign-ctx20260921-03 -- mockup image generation was still async ('Mockups are still publishing') at the time of capture; product page itself was confirmed published.
unknowns: Whether the empty/broken category-item listing (3 surfaces: asset-picker tree, inline Design-Settings search box firing zero requests, group layer's default-value combobox) is a genuine current product defect, a staging-only data/cache issue, or store-specific -- not diagnosed further per portal-explorer's non-judging mandate. Recommend api-explorer cross-check GET /api/layer-image-categories?type=clipart directly and db-explorer check whether clipart_categories rows for user 266 have any missing FK/flag that this endpoint filters on.

Whether 'Select a group of clipart categories' truly supports selecting MULTIPLE categories (a real merchant-facing multi-select 'group'), or whether 'group' actually refers to a category that itself has child/nested sub-categories (the 'Parent Category' field seen on the category form) with only ONE top-level category assignable per layer. Only a single-selection UI ('Selected: <name>' with one clear-X) was observed; no way to add a 2nd category was found in the time available. Needs a follow-up run with a category that has children to confirm.

Whether the Preview/Thumbnail size setting change (thumbnail 100px->300px) produces any portal-visible pixel effect -- could not verify because the only portal UI that consumes category items for rendering (asset-picker tree, group default-value combobox) was non-functional throughout this session. Deferred entirely to storefront-explorer per task boundary (TASK-5b/5c).

Purpose and behavior of 'grouped_reposition' array (observed empty []) on the group-clipart-categories layer JSON -- not explored (would require adding 2+ categories to the group, blocked by the single-selection observation above).
